Topologically ordered integer elimination reproduced the critical masks and the two displayed degree-three and degree-four matrices. The frozen 25-term chain is an integral cycle and its projections are [912] and −[660]+[792]. Removing the empty-face pair restores one critical vertex and retains the reduced calculation. For cutoff three the degree −1 attachment to the 2-sphere gives a contractible subcomplex consisting of the 2-sphere and that 3-cell, whose quotient leaves three 3-spheres below the two 4-cells. The two primitive independent relations identify the other two basis elements with x=[792]−[660]; their degree vectors give a free direct summand, so the cofiber is a 3-sphere. Cutoff two also has the sphere model; the inclusion carries one integral generator to the other, so it is a homotopy equivalence. The sign +1 pertains to the specified generators.
